issues.description: Percent signs ('%') appear unescaped (e.g. '80 %', '50 %'). In LaTeX a percent sign starts a comment unless escaped as '\%'. There is also at least one probable typo ('nasadťe') that may break compilation or is incorrect orthographically.
issues.required_fix: Escape all percent signs (e.g. '80\%', '50\%'). Fix typographical errors (e.g. correct 'nasadťe') and verify that all non-ASCII characters are encoded correctly for the document's LaTeX engine. Re-run a LaTeX compile check after edits.
